Independent finite replay: directly sum cos(k(x_i−x_j))/N for −n≤k≤n and apply real symmetric Jacobi diagonalization at N=5,7,13,17 and η=0.12,0.43,0.79,0.001; max spectrum error 2.34e−15. At η=0.001, relative deviations from the scaled leading coefficients were below 2.44e−7 for the least singular value and 1.76e−7 for the condition number.
correctness.rationale: Right multiplication by the adjoint of the unperturbed unitary matrix leaves two modified rows over an identity block. The upper-left matrix has diagonal a and off-diagonal b, and the full two-row Gram block has diagonal 1 and off-diagonal c. Subtracting the upper-left Gram gives the two row norms squared γ_s=1+sc−(a+sb)² in the parity basis; the projected rows are orthogonal. Consequently there are N−4 unit modes and two 2×2 Gram blocks of trace 2+sc and determinant (a+sb)². In fact each γ_s is positive in the named regime: reflection interchanges retained sites j=2 and j=N−1, where the first modified cardinal row has two negative, unequal entries proportional to −1/sin((2h−δ)/2) and −1/sin((h+δ)/2), respectively. Their parity sum and difference are both nonzero. The roots are positive since a>b>0, and each parity block straddles 1. At collision c=1+O_N(η²), a+b=2d_N+O_N(η²), and the odd difference is −hD'_n(h/2)η/N+O_N(η³)=K_Nη+O_N(η³). The odd large root tends to 1, so dividing the odd determinant by it gives the square of the least singular value. The even top is separated and varies by O_N(η²), yielding the stated condition-number coefficient and remainder. The even collision roots are strictly positive with a nonzero gap, since N sin(π/(2N)) increases with N and is already √2 at N=2. The limit N→∞ of the fixed-N coefficients uses sinc at zero; this is not a uniform joint-limit claim.
residual_risks: The finite replay is floating point and corroborative only; the conclusions and O-terms follow from the fixed-N argument.

value.rationale: The square complete-band Fourier grid is a natural interpolation benchmark. Its symmetric pair collision admits an exact answer beyond the known conditioning scale: the four changing modes are resolved, their positivity is explicit, and the sharp numerical blowup coefficient and fixed-size error follow. The distinction between the least singular value and the condition number matters because the top singular value has a non-unit limit.
residual_risks: Restricted to this symmetric pair and the specified consecutive band; not a generic cluster theorem.
